newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clarins would look at Sanofi Beaute.
newsitem.headline: Clarins would look at Sanofi Beaute.

text.p: French cosmetics group Clarins said on Wednesday that it would look at Sanofi Beaute and Yves Saint Laurent if they were for sale but that it believed they were not on the market.

Clarins shares were up 4.20 percent at 794 francs at 1328 GMT after an earlier day high of 809 francs and Sanofi's stock was up 2.34 percent at 569 francs, while and the CAC-40 leading share index was up 1.44 percent at the same time.

"The management of Clarins said that Sanofi and Yves Saint Laurent were not for sale to their knowledge and that it they were Clarins would look at the dossier," a Clarins spokesman told Reuters, referring to proceedings at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on Wednesday.
